page_title: MAL 1-1 ALA | Mallorca v Alaves 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Carlos Martin (Alaves) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Dominik Greif makes a save.
90+4' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

90+1' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Antonio Sivera pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Rodriguez leaves the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on.
84' None of the Mallorca players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

83' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.
83' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
81' Substitution. Moussa Diarra (Alaves) on for Manu Sanchez.
81' Here is a change. Carlos Vicente is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Facundo Garces (Alaves).
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Ander Guevara (Alaves) coming on for Joan Jordan.
80' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' The foul by Santiago Mourino (Alaves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Cesar Soto Grado.
77' The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
76' Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes a long-range first-time shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an amazing diving save.
74' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

73' Toni Martinez (Alaves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Dominik Greif. Alaves get a corner.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Omar Mascarell will be replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
72' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Robert Navarro and he is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
71' Problems for Eduardo Coudet as Kike Garcia (Alaves) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Toni Martinez replaces him.

68' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Kike Garcia (Alaves) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Carlos Martin. The score is now 1:1.
68' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

67' Alaves are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Substitution. Takuma Asano will be replaced by Samu Costa (Mallorca).
64' Carles Alena (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Cesar Soto Grado ignores the protests.

64' What a wasted opportunity by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Antonio Sivera makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
63' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

63' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Antonio Sivera, who pulls off a stunning save! Mallorca win a corner.
62' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
60' Carlos Martin (Alaves) produces a good strike that sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
59' A cross from a corner kick by Alaves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

58' Carles Alena (Alaves) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Dominik Greif was alert and the score remains the same. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Wow, what an escape. Kike Garcia (Alaves) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
55' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

54' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
53' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Antonio Blanco (Alaves) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
51' 37:63 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
49' Carles Alena (Alaves) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
48' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Antonio Blanco (Alaves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Carlos Martin (Alaves) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Dominik Greif.
42' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
39' Dangerous play by Antonio Blanco (Alaves). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
38' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Alaves show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Alaves will take a corner kick.
37' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
31' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

30' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

29' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
28' Mallorca are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

26' Good chance! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.

25' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
24' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
22' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
21' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
18' Carles Alena (Alaves) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
16' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Now Alaves have a corner.
13' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
12' Wonderful movement by Alaves. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

9' 1 - 0 Takuma Asano (Mallorca) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight under the crossbar. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.

7' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Alaves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

2' Alaves slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Cesar Soto Grado.
